
I would like you to reverse engineer a gate-level netlist back to its original RTL description.
The netlist was synthesized from a Verilog RTL design.

Please create an equivalent, clean, and readable RTL description that implements the same functionality.
Your RTL should be written in standard Verilog or SystemVerilog using best practices.

The module should be named 'TopModule' with the following interface:
clk, areset, x, z

Gate-level netlist:
```verilog

module RefModule(clk, areset, x, z);
  wire _00_;
  wire _01_;
  wire _02_;
  wire _03_;
  wire _04_;
  wire _05_;
  wire _06_;
  wire _07_;
  wire _08_;
  input areset;
  wire areset;
  input clk;
  wire clk;
  wire [2:0] state;
  input x;
  wire x;
  output z;
  wire z;
  NOT _09_ (
    .A(x),
    .Y(_07_)
  );
  NOT _10_ (
    .A(state[0]),
    .Y(_08_)
  );
  NAND _11_ (
    .A(x),
    .B(state[0]),
    .Y(_03_)
  );
  NOR _12_ (
    .A(state[1]),
    .B(state[2]),
    .Y(_04_)
  );
  NOR _13_ (
    .A(x),
    .B(_04_),
    .Y(_05_)
  );
  NOT _14_ (
    .A(_05_),
    .Y(_06_)
  );
  NAND _15_ (
    .A(_03_),
    .B(_06_),
    .Y(_02_)
  );
  NOR _16_ (
    .A(x),
    .B(_08_),
    .Y(_00_)
  );
  NOR _17_ (
    .A(_07_),
    .B(_04_),
    .Y(_01_)
  );
  DFFSR _18_ (
    .C(clk),
    .D(_00_),
    .Q(state[0]),
    .R(1'h0),
    .S(areset)
  );
  DFFSR _19_ (
    .C(clk),
    .D(_02_),
    .Q(state[1]),
    .R(areset),
    .S(1'h0)
  );
  DFFSR _20_ (
    .C(clk),
    .D(_01_),
    .Q(state[2]),
    .R(areset),
    .S(1'h0)
  );
  assign z = state[1];
endmodule
```
